title: Cloud Administrator - Azure & AWS
description:
Job Title: Cloud Administrator Azure & AWS 
 Experience: 3–5 Years
 Work Location: Work From Office (WFO - Kochi)
 Shift: 24/7 Rotational Shifts
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Cloud Administrator with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud environments. The candidate will be responsible for administering, managing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and reliability. Key Responsibilities Cloud Administration: Manage Azure and AWS subscriptions, cloud resources, and infrastructure configurations. Identity & Access Management: Manage users, roles, permissions, access policies, and authentication. Compute Management: Provision, configure, monitor, and maintain cloud-based virtual machines and compute resources. Network Administration: Manage virtual networks, subnets, routing, firewalls, security groups, and connectivity. Storage & Database Administration: Manage cloud storage, backups, and database infrastructure. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and maintain infrastructure automation using relevant IaC tools. Monitoring & Incident Management: Monitor cloud environments, troubleshoot issues, resolve incidents, and ensure service availability. Security & Compliance: Implement cloud security best practices, access controls, and compliance requirements. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Manage backup policies, recovery procedures, and disaster recovery operations. Cost Optimization: Monitor cloud usage and expenses and identify opportunities to optimize infrastructure costs. Patching & Maintenance: Perform regular patching, updates, upgrades, and preventive maintenance. Governance & Reporting: Maintain cloud governance standards, operational documentation, and periodic reports. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 3–5 years of experience in cloud administration or cloud infrastructure management. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS services. Strong understanding of cloud subscriptions, compute, networking, storage, and access management. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud automation. Experience in cloud monitoring, troubleshooting, patch management, and incident resolution. Understanding of cloud security, compliance, backup, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of cloud cost management and governance practices. Good analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Willingness to work in 24/7 rotational shifts from the office. 
 Key Skills 
 Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloud Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, Compute Management, Network Administration, Storage Management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Security, Monitoring, Incident Management, Backup & Disaster Recovery, Cost Optimization, Patching, Governance.

title: Nutanix Engineer(HCI)
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled Nutanix Security Engineer to design, implement, secure, and manage Nutanix infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Nutanix HCI, virtualization technologies, cybersecurity best practices, and cloud security. The role focuses on ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of enterprise infrastructure while maintaining compliance with organizational security standards. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Nutanix Infrastructure Security Design, implement, and maintain secure Nutanix HCI environments. Configure and manage Nutanix Prism Central, Prism Element, AHV, and related services. Implement security hardening and best practices for Nutanix clusters. Perform vulnerability assessments and security audits on Nutanix infrastructure. Security Operations Monitor security events, logs, and s related to Nutanix environments. Investigate and respond to security incidents affecting Nutanix platforms. Implement and manage role-based access control (RBAC), MFA, and privileged access management. Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements. Network Cloud Security Secure Nutanix networking components, micro-segmentation, and virtual networks. Integrate Nutanix environments with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Implement secure connectivity and encryption mechanisms. Risk Compliance Perform security risk assessments and recommend remediation actions. Support compliance initiatives such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR. Develop and maintain security documentation, procedures, and standards. Automation Continuous Improvement Automate security monitoring and compliance checks using scripting tools. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to enhance platform security. Stay current with Nutanix product updates, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats. 
 
 Required Skills 
 Technical Skills: Strong experience with Nutanix HCI, AHV, Prism Central, and Prism Element. Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, AHV). Experience with security tools such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners, and IAM solutions. Understanding of network security concepts including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and segmentation. Experience with Linux and Windows administration. Knowledge of cloud security principles across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Security Knowledge: Infrastructure security and hardening. Vulnerability management. Identity and Access Management (IAM). Data encryption and key management. Incident response and threat analysis. Security compliance and governance frameworks. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field. Equivalent industry experience may be considered. Experience: 5+ years of Infrastructure or Security Engineering experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Nutanix technologies. Experience supporting enterprise-scale, highly available environments. Certifications: Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP) Nutanix Certified Expert (NCX) CISSP CISM CEH CCSP AWS/Azure Security Certifications. Key Competencies: Problem-solving and analytical skills. Security risk assessment and mitigation. Strong communication and stakeholder management. Ability to work in cross-functional teams. Documentation and process-oriented mindset. This JD is suitable for mid-to-senior level Nutanix Security Engineer positions (5-10 years experience).

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
This role is intended for an experienced Cloud Architect with strong cloud and backend development expertise who enjoys building reliable software systems that integrate with industrial equipment. The Cloud Solutions Architect will implement, deploy, and sustain cloud-connected applications, backend services, software infrastructure, and shared technology platforms supporting NOV's Service Equipment product portfolio. Working closely with engineering leadership and system architects, this individual will translate architectural direction into scalable, production-ready solutions while providing technical mentorship, promoting software engineering best practices, and taking ownership of the reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement of the software platform. 
 Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and support cloud-based software platforms and backend services supporting NOV Service Equipment products. Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, containerized applications, and production software environments. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate industrial equipment with cloud services, databases, APIs, and enterprise applications. Troubleshoot complex software, infrastructure, networking, and system integration issues across development and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment processes. Mentor software engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and collaborative problem solving. Develop reusable software frameworks and shared platform capabilities that support multiple product lines. Support software validation, release management, and remote deployment activities for production systems. Take technical ownership of assigned software platforms and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or applicable experience. Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production software systems. Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based applications using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong experience developing backend software, REST APIs, databases, containerized applications, and modern software development practices. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. United State travel Visa preferred. 
 Success Factors: Demonstrates technical ownership by taking responsibility for software platforms and driving complex technical issues through resolution. Builds reliable, maintainable, and scalable software systems with a long-term product mindset. Communicates proactively, collaborates effectively across distributed engineering teams, and mentors other engineers through technical leadership. Continuously evaluates opportunities to improve software architecture, development processes, deployment practices, and operational reliability. Approaches technical challenges with curiosity, professionalism, and a commitment to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
